I am sorry @Kikobeats could you please explain exactly, in clear words:
- what are you trying to achieve
- what are the missing API entries to achieve it easily

I am trying to understand what is wrong but going through your screenshots of SASS styles and the long DOM node that I have to diff is not as easy as I thought it would be. Thanks

The point is I'm trying to apply style and I dont want user very specific selectors, like:

```
.ais-CurrentRefinements__item:not(.ais-CurrentRefinements__itemParent)
```

Because currently not exist a class for select the element. 

So I suggest you unique class for each element of the markup.
I updated `after` markup to make more easy understand my intention.
Ok so basically you want to be able to easily distinguish items from sub items in current refinements, is that it?
